headline: Every Match Leaves
a Legacy.
hero.subheadline: Under the floodlights, four pitch domains still hold the game — Front, Mid, Box, and Back. Collect cards, build manager decks, and trade on a night-market before Rival Defense closes the shape.

paragraphs: The pitch remembers every line. A force called Attack pushes to break shape, while Defense holds the legacy — the structure that lets Front finish, Mid dictate, Box scramble, and Back claim.
As Attack presses inward, squads grow restless. Managers must not only win their matches, but keep these pitch pockets coherent before the last clean shape dissolves into chaos.
